attribute_information.actual_dim: The number of days after calving the blood sample was taken
attribute_information.bhb: BHB (ketone) level in the blood sample
attribute_information.cow_id: The ID number associated with the cow
attribute_information.date: Date the blood sample was taken
attribute_information.glucose: Glucose level in the blood sample
attribute_information.notes: Any details about that particular blood sample (ex: issues with collection, strange blood appearance, etc.)
attribute_information.sample: The sample number for that particular cow
attribute_information.trmt: The treatment assigned to the cow; 1 = flat rate of concentrate, 2 = concentrate based on milk production, 3 = concentrate based on milk production and feed intake
